newsitem.title: UK: CIS lead, zinc industries stabilising - Roskill.
newsitem.headline: CIS lead, zinc industries stabilising - Roskill.

text.p: Rationalisation of the lead and zinc industries in the CIS has taken place naturally, following a period of falling production, and the situation at the major combines has stabilised, industry specialists Roskill Information Services said.

In a special report on the lead/zinc industries, Roskill said the break-up of the former USSR, the lack of integration in the lead and zinc sector, and a reduction in industrial activity led to a sharp drop in concentrate output in Kazakhstan, Georgia, Uzbekistan, Tadjikistan and Russia.
"Some organizations, such as Uchaly GOK, Gorevsky GOK and the Zyryanovs lead combine have survived the difficult conditions...suggesting that the drop in production has been arrested," Roskill said.

However, the CIS lead and zinc industries will need significant investment before there is a major increase in output. Nearly all CIS producers are suffering from a shortage of raw materials, it said.
